name: Void Code Editor
summary: New open-source AI code editor alternative to Cursor that connects to local or self-hosted LLMs with zero third-party telemetry.
impact: Eliminates $20/month AI editor subscriptions while keeping source code 100% on local storage.

name: Kokoro TTS
summary: Lightweight 82M open-source text-to-speech engine matching commercial voice naturalness at $0 cost.
impact: Can run offline on standard consumer CPUs without expensive GPU cloud requirements or API character quotas.

name: Evernote Free Tier
summary: Evernote capped free basic accounts to a strict limit of 1 notebook and 50 notes total.
impact: Users prompted into $129.99/yr subscription. Recommended free replacement: Joplin, Obsidian, or Notesnook.

name: Docker Desktop
summary: Enforced subscription fees for companies with >250 employees or >$10M annual revenue.
impact: Recommended free drop-in replacements: Rancher Desktop, Colima, or Podman Desktop (free & open source).

name: Bruno API Client
summary: Fast, git-friendly open-source API desktop client that stores collections directly in local folders.
impact: Replaces Postman (which phased out scratchpad mode and moved team collections into mandatory cloud sync with limits).

name: Trello Free Tier
summary: Atlassian limited free Trello Workspaces to a maximum of 10 collaborators across all boards.
impact: Teams requiring unlimited members can switch to Focalboard, Wekan, or Taiga.

name: Apache OpenOffice
summary: Project releases remain infrequent with slow CVE patching cycles compared to modern office suites.
impact: All users are strongly advised to migrate to active LibreOffice, which receives frequent security and compatibility updates.

name: Adobe Creative Cloud
summary: Adobe raised global pricing across standalone Single App subscriptions ($22.99/mo) and All Apps bundles ($59.99/mo).
impact: Average annual expense now exceeds $720/yr. Accelerated user migration to Affinity, DaVinci Resolve, Blender, and GIMP.
